comment: Great professor if you put in the work

Do all the work, come to every class, participate as much as possible and may be you will get a B+. Good luck to figure out how he grades work. However, I liked his classes, he really makes you think and challenges your point of view. Very provoking so be prepared to feel a little uncomfortable sometimes.
One of my favorite classes. This guy is the most thought-provoking professor out there. I wish he taught more. Great dynamics. Also pretty easy on the eyes. He's a real person.
Don't take his class. Take another teacher. Participation grades are completely subjective and he gives out bad ones.
Amazing professor. If you do the reading, which really isn't too much and talk class its simple. Very intelligent, capable professor.
He is the man and I loved his class.  He is not easy, but not hard at all.  40% of the grade is participation so speak up a lot or you will not do well.  I would take him again.

Dr. Phillips expects everyone to be prepared and participate in class.  There are not many opportunities for graded assignments, so it's important to participate because participation is 40% of the grade. May seem like a hard ass but is very helpful and his class will grow on you.

40% of the grade consists of participation. So this can either be an easy class or a hard class for you, depending on how much you like to participate. If you're somewhat quiet and reserved than this is not the class for you, but if you have an opinion on everything and aren't afraid to share it then you'll do great.

I found Business Ethics to be a very enjoyable class. The workload is fairly light, only requires a 5-15 page reading before class, one final, and one presentation. Dr. Phillips comes off as intimidating, but if you go and talk to him you find out he's not. He respects and cares about his students.
Class is pretty useless, but he is not bad to look at :)
Stay away from him. Very hard grader for such a useless class. Take Porcher instead.
Pretty good professor and very smart. Class is based on articles discussion and presentations. He is extremely good looking.

excellent teacher and extremely good at facilitating class discussion.  not a difficult class... only requires one 20 minute presentation, and a short reading before each class.  final is take home.  you'd be stupid not to take him.
steer far from this class. very difficult grader. too smart to teach the class and he knows it. if you want to do well in this required course for the B School you probably do not want to take him.
Phillips is a very interesting guy with a lot of character. He respects his students' opinions and the class is completely discussion-based. Plus, he's not too bad to look at :)
